mapper.select: SELECT ci.id AS itemId, ci.product_id AS productId, ci.quantity, ci.version, p.sku, p.name, p.cover_image AS coverImage, p.price, p.stock, p.status, (p.price * ci.quantity) AS lineAmount FROM cart_item ci JOIN product p ON p.id = ci.product_id WHERE ci.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY ci.created_at, ci.id
SELECT * FROM cart_item WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY product_id FOR UPDATE
